description: This Java class, CheckExternalFilter, is a final, immutable implementation that extends AbstractHeaderEntryFilter. Its purpose is to filter headers based on their definitions to determine whether they can be read from or written to external headers. It provides static factory methods to create filters for different conditions related to external headers. The class heavily relies on the HeaderDefinition interface and predicates to evaluate header properties.

classes.name: CheckExternalFilter
classes.description: Immutable filter class that checks header definitions for external read/write permission, extending AbstractHeaderEntryFilter.

methods.name: shouldReadFromExternal
methods.description: Creates a filter instance that allows reading from external headers based on header definitions.

methods.name: shouldWriteToExternal
methods.description: Creates a filter instance that allows writing to external headers based on header definitions.

methods.name: existsAsHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Creates a filter to check for existence of a header definition for a given header key.
